description: Delegate a focused task to a subagent that works in its own context and returns a final summary. Must be used for self-contained research or multi-step sub-tasks.
name: agent

max_steps.description: Model turns the subagent may use (default 12, max 20).

profile.description: Optional preset: never, explore, plan, code or review (a user preset may be listed below). `never` is grep/glob-only with read-only isolation. A preset picks a subset of the parent's tools (never agent); the guard still decides every effect. Omit for the generic subagent.

task.description: The task for the subagent. Write it self-contained: the subagent cannot see this conversation.

description: Apply a freeform patch in the GPT-5/Codex apply_patch format. The single `input` string must be wrapped in '*** Begin Patch' / '*** End Patch' and use '*** Add File: <path>', '*** Update File: <path>' (with '@@' context chunks of ' ' context, '-' deletions and '+' additions, optionally '*** End of File'), '*** Delete File: <path>' and '*** Move to: <path>'. Context is matched with a graded fuzz ladder; chunks that cannot be located are skipped with a warning.
name: apply_patch

input.description: The full patch text, from '*** Begin Patch' to '*** End Patch'. Every Add File body line starts with '+'; Update chunks use ' '/'-'/'+' line prefixes under '@@' headers.

description: Structural replace in one file: match a pattern with metavariables ($NAME / $$$NAME) and substitute them into a replacement template. Every occurrence is replaced. Goes through the write guard and the preimage safety check, like edit.
name: ast_edit

lang.description: Optional language or extension hint selecting the lexer family (e.g. rust/rs for lifetimes, py/python/sh/yaml for # comments); default is inferred from the file extension, else C-like.

out.description: Replacement template; $NAME / $$$NAME expand to captured text.

description: Structural (AST-style) pattern search. Metavariables: $NAME (one token), $$$NAME (a run of tokens). Uses a built-in structural matcher; an external ast-grep binary is used only when present and only through the guard.
name: ast_search

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob, e.g. '*.ts'.

lang.description: Optional language or extension hint (e.g. rust/rs, py/python). Selects the built-in matcher's lexer family (comments, quotes) and is passed to an external ast-grep; default is inferred from each file extension.

path.description: File or directory to search (default: workspace).

description: Run a JavaScript program in an isolated Bun subprocess to chain tool calls, filter large outputs, and compute. Use `await tools.call(name, args)` to call tools; console.log is collected; `return` a value to get it back.
name: code_mode

code.description: Async function body. `tools.call(name, args)` bridges to the tools; return the value you want back.

description: Debugger over DAP. stack/variables are read-only; launch/attach keep a live adapter for the chat session; continue/next/stepIn/stepOut reuse it; close disposes. Pass command, or adapter name from defaults (debugpy/gdb/…), or let launch auto-pick from program extension. OMP sequencing in session.ts.
name: debug

adapter.description: Named adapter from dap/defaults.json (e.g. debugpy, gdb, lldb-dap); resolved via PATH.

args.description: Argv tail for the adapter (optional; merged after catalogue defaults).

command.description: Executable that speaks DAP on stdio (optional when adapter is set).

op.description: stack, variables, launch, attach, close, continue, next (step over), stepIn, or stepOut.

pid.description: Process id to attach (attach op; admitted as shell.exec).

port.description: Debug port to attach (attach op; with optional host).

program.description: Debuggee command line (required for launch and step ops; admitted as shell.exec).

description: Replace a string in a file: exact match, then relative-indent, three-way-merge and line-patch repair rungs (each only when unambiguous). All occurrences or the first only. Alternatively, address whole lines by the anchors read returns with anchors:true (start_anchor, optional end_anchor) instead of old.
name: edit

end_anchor.description: Anchored mode: last line to replace (default start_anchor).

old.description: String to replace (must not be empty). Omit when using start_anchor.

start_anchor.description: Anchored mode: first line to replace, LINE:abc:def from read anchors:true. Replaces old; the whole line range becomes new (empty new deletes).

description: Find files matching a glob pattern, newest-agnostic name order.
name: glob

description: Search file contents for a regex or text pattern.
name: grep

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob, e.g. '*.ts'.

path.description: File or directory to search (default: workspace).

pattern.description: Regex (or literal text) to search for.

description: Store a session handoff under the workspace (.hz/state/handoffs.db). Summary required; optional tried/next/blockers/decisions/files/context. No todos section — use todo tool instead.
name: handoff_create

continues_from.description: Prior handoff id to chain from (optional).

description: Resume from the latest handoff on the current branch (or detached workspace scope). Walks continues_from chain (max 5). Optional BM25 query ranks sections.
name: handoff_resume

handoff_id.description: Start from a specific handoff id.

description: BM25 search across handoff section text for the current branch scope.
name: handoff_search

section_filter.description: Limit to section names (e.g. tried, blockers).

description: Compiler-grade diagnostics for a file: runs the language-server path and returns only severity error lines (warnings omitted).
name: lint

description: Language-server diagnostics for a file. op:'diagnostics' (path required) syncs the file to any configured language server and reports only fresh diagnostics; a no-op when no server is configured for the file type.
name: lsp

description: Search user-curated memory (FTS BM25). Default bank is project (MEMORY.md under .hz/). Use scope shared_recall to search project, user, and shared banks with bank labels on hits.
name: memory_search

banks.description: Optional explicit bank list (overrides scope when set).

query.description: Terms to search for in remembered facts.

scope.description: Search scope: project (default), user, shared, or shared_recall / all (cross-bank recall with bank id on each hit).

description: Declare the final file paths that satisfy the task (deliverables). Does not modify files; records intent for the session summary.
name: present

files.description: Workspace-relative paths that are the intended final outputs.

description: Start, stop, or check a local preview server for the project (dev server, static server, or an explicit command).
name: preview

command.description: Explicit command to run (defaults to the package.json dev or start script).

cwd.description: Working directory for the server, inside the workspace (defaults to the workspace).

id.description: Preview id to stop (from `status`; any session may stop any preview).

port.description: Expected port, used to spot the URL in the server output.

description: Read a text file with line numbers, optionally a line range.
name: read

anchors.description: Prefix each line with a LINE:abc:def anchor usable by edit start_anchor/end_anchor (default false).

limit.description: Maximum lines to return (default and cap 2000).

offset.description: 1-based line to start at (default 1). Negative values count from the end (e.g. -100 = last 100 lines).

paths.description: Optional batch: read multiple paths; returns a JSON array of per-path ok/output/error (never fails the whole call on one bad path).

description: Produce a token-budgeted structural map of the repository (top definitions per file, ranked by relevance). For orientation without reading everything.
name: repo_map

fallbackLadder.description: When true (default), climb focus → repo → plain max-budget ladder if the map would be empty.

fileCursor.description: Ranked-file offset for paging; use nextFileCursor from a prior truncated map.

focus.description: Files to personalise the ranking toward, e.g. the files under discussion.

symbolCursor.description: Definition-row offset (after fileCursor slice) for symbol-level paging; use nextSymbolCursor from a prior truncated map.

description: Run a bash command in the workspace and return its combined output and exit code.
name: shell

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the workspace (default: workspace).

description: Drive an interactive terminal session: start a command in a persistent PTY-backed session (mode:start), feed it stdin (mode:write), or terminate it (mode:close). Unlike the one-shot shell tool, this is the explicit opt-in for interactive programs. Every start, and every input line written later, is authorized as its own shell.exec effect.
name: shell_session

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the workspace (mode:start; default: workspace).

idleMs.description: Idle timeout in ms with no read/write before the session is killed (mode:start; default 120000).

input.description: Text to feed to the session's stdin (mode:write). Include a trailing newline to submit a line.

mode.description: start a new session, write stdin to a running one, or close it.

sessionId.description: The session id returned by a start (mode:write / mode:close).

timeoutMs.description: Overall wall-clock budget in ms (mode:start; default 120000, max 600000).

description: Maintain the session todo checklist: list, add, or complete items.
name: todo

text.description: Item text for 'add', or the item id (e.g. 't1') for 'done'.

description: Search for additional (deferred) tools by describing what you need. Matching tools are unlocked for the rest of the session and their full specs are returned so you can call them immediately.
name: tool_search

query.description: What you want to do (e.g. 'start a dev server on localhost'). Matched against deferred tool names, descriptions, and keywords.

description: Revert the most recent write or edit the workspace recorded (the newest live change, any session, or the newest one to `path`). Restores the previous content, or removes a file the change created. Refuses when the file changed since, or when the previous content was not kept.
name: undo

path.description: Undo the most recent change to this file instead of the newest change overall.

description: Create or overwrite a file, creating parent directories as needed.
name: write

force.description: Overwrite a binary or non-UTF-8 file. Without it such a target is refused.
